description: Golden vectors for the compact binary form of Roadstr road-event reports (Nostr kind 1315) and confirmations (kind 1316). 'valid': decoding binaryHex (with 'reference' for confirmations) must rebuild exactly 'event' (same id, pubkey, sig) and the signature must verify; encoding 'event' must give exactly binaryHex (except flags, which are not signed). 'invalid': decoding must fail with expectStrict. 'nonRepresentable': encoding must be refused with expectEncode. 'tolerated': genuine events with a known client bug (decimal comma) that a reader may accept but that must never be encoded. 'referenceTruncation': binaries emitted by the truncating reference encoder; strict decoding fails, tolerant decoding must recover expectedEventId.
warning: All private keys here are public test keys. Never use them for anything else.

valid.name: report-negative-both
valid.note: Both coordinates negative (int32 two's complement, '-' sign).

valid.name: report-sub-degree-negative
valid.note: Negative values below one degree keep their sign and leading 0.

valid.name: report-ephemeral-flag
valid.note: Flags byte 0x04. The flag is not signed: decoders treat it as a hint only.

valid.name: report-created-at-uint32-max
valid.note: Largest uint32; the expiration tag (+14 d) no longer fits in 32 bits.

valid.name: report-type-other
valid.note: Type 255 is representable only with an empty content.

valid.name: report-truncation-trap-a
valid.note: (35.1976312*1e7).toLong() == 351976311 in IEEE-754: a truncating encoder is off by one.

valid.name: report-truncation-trap-b
valid.note: Same trap with the sign on the other axis.

valid.name: report-geohash-boundary-zero
valid.note: lon one LSB below the first longitude split.

valid.name: report-geohash-boundary-split
valid.note: Exactly on level-1 geohash split lines.

valid.name: confirmation-negative-coordinates
valid.note: The referenced report has negative coordinates.

valid.name: confirmation-by-report-author
valid.note: Same key as the report: still a valid, independent event.

invalid.name: report-too-short
invalid.note: 109 bytes: the SPECIFICATION heading says 109, the table sums to 110.

invalid.name: report-reserved-bit-0
invalid.note: Bits 1-0 are reserved and must be zero in v1.

invalid.name: report-flagged-as-confirmation
invalid.note: A 110-byte frame with the confirmation bit set is neither of the two layouts.

invalid.name: report-unknown-type-12
invalid.note: Values 12-254 are reserved; they must NOT be mapped to 'other' (that would change the signed bytes).

invalid.name: report-tampered-pubkey
invalid.note: May also fail as an invalid x-only point; both map to SIGNATURE_INVALID.

invalid.name: report-all-zero
invalid.note: Structurally valid (v1, report, police at 0,0) but unsigned.

invalid.name: confirmation-status-2
invalid.note: Status is 0 or 1; anything else is malformed.

invalid.name: confirmation-status-flipped
invalid.note: A relay flipping still_there into no_longer_there invalidates the signature.

invalid.name: confirmation-tampered-reference-id
invalid.note: The report named by the damaged ID is resolved (same coordinates), but the signature covers the original ID.

invalid.name: confirmation-reference-is-another-report
invalid.note: The caller resolved a different report than the one the frame names.

invalid.name: confirmation-wrong-reference-coordinates
invalid.note: The signed event embeds the report's coordinates: reconstructing it with a different report's coordinates must fail.

nonRepresentable.name: content-is-not-empty
nonRepresentable.note: NIP: 'Events with non-empty .content cannot be represented in binary form.'

nonRepresentable.name: tags-in-roadstr-native-order
nonRepresentable.note: Same information, different tag order -> different event ID.

nonRepresentable.name: negative-zero-latitude
nonRepresentable.note: A formatter that prints -0.0000000 produces an event no binary can reproduce.

nonRepresentable.name: expiration-is-type-ttl
nonRepresentable.note: SPECIFICATION.md section 3.2 example (created_at + 2 h); the NIP and the client fix it at +14 d.

nonRepresentable.name: alt-missing
nonRepresentable.note: alt is optional in the NIP but required to rebuild the ID.

nonRepresentable.name: alt-differs
nonRepresentable.note: SPECIFICATION.md section 13.3 example; the NIP requires the exact canonical text.

nonRepresentable.name: unknown-type
nonRepresentable.note: Mapping it to 255 would silently change the signed 't' tag.

nonRepresentable.name: geohash-does-not-match-coordinates
nonRepresentable.note: The g5/g6 values printed in SPECIFICATION.md section 15.1 for these coordinates; the real ones are u09tv/u09tvw.

nonRepresentable.name: created-at-does-not-fit-uint32
nonRepresentable.note: Otherwise canonical: only the 32-bit timestamp field makes it unrepresentable.

tolerated.name: report-decimal-comma
tolerated.note: Seen in the wild (Slovak locale). A reader MAY show it; it can never be rebuilt from a frame.
